name: A J. Gross and Sons
description: A J. Gross and Sons is a working farm in 817 Wheats Valley Road, VA. It grows Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples, with seasonal availability through spring, summer, autumn, and winter. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Apr – Jun in this growing zone.
